cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js | head -120; echo ---; grep -n -i -A25 "dropdownmenu" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ ; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite)$"

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/; grep -rn "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/types.d.ts | head; grep -rn "theme?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/*.d.ts | head
